subject: Renewal: capacity readout and roll-forward proposal
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@velocit.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@velocit.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden spike + renewal coming up (May) — can we roll forward capacity?

Hi Hannah,

Quick note ahead of our renewal in May. Over the last three weeks we've seen an unexpected rise in inference traffic tied to a new feature we shipped. Peak sustained tokens/day jumped ~3x and our current committed capacity will leave us throttled mid-quarter.

Attached is the weekly usage snapshot and a short export of top routes. Raj on procurement is looped for timing. Two asks:
- Can Redwood proposal a short-term roll-forward to cover the next 60 days while we finalize longer-term commit?
- Any quick performance/latency variance you've observed that may affect the pricing we should expect?

We want to avoid service interruptions for our pilot customers. Happy to hop on a 30-min call — mornings PT work best.

Thanks,
Samantha
VP Product, VelocitAI
[Attachment: velocit_weekly_usage_report_Q1.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@velocit.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@velocit.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden spike + renewal coming up (May) — can we roll forward capacity?

Samantha — thanks for the heads-up and the report; very helpful.

Short answers up front: yes, we can do a 60-day roll-forward and we have some interim capacity options to keep latency within your current SLOs. I ran a quick pass on the attached usage and a couple of notes:
- Observed token mix shift: higher long-context chat sessions drove KV-cache misses — this explains the higher token count and modest latency variance (~10-15ms increase on p95).
- Recommended short term: +40% committed tokens for 60 days (keeps cost predictable and avoids throttling).
- Longer term: we should profile top 5 routes for quantization/replication savings — potential 18-25% unit-cost reduction.

I'm attaching a brief Redwood performance summary (redwood_perf_summary.csv) and a draft roll-forward term (v1). Connor, can you take point on pricing/contract amendment? Marissa, can you validate ops readiness for a +40% commit?

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm numbers.
2) Connor to share a draft amendment and projected monthly spend.
3) If agreed, DocuSign for a 60-day roll-forward and then rebaseline for Q3 commit.

Hannah
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | +1 415 555 0123
[Attachment: redwood_perf_summary.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha@velocit.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@velocit.ai>
Date: 2027-04-08T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden spike + renewal coming up (May) — can we roll forward capacity?

Looping in the ops and success perspective. Quick operational notes:
- We can provision the extra capacity within 24 hours of agreement (no infra changes required on VelocitAI side).
- I ran a quick simulation on your top 3 routes with the additional +40% commit — cache hit improved slightly due to persistent pads, which reduces avg token-processing time. Expect end-to-end latency p95 to remain within SLA for the short window.
- For reporting, I recommend we send a daily condensed usage email (auto) and a weekly deep-dive to your engineering leads so they can flag anomalies quickly.

On ROI framing: given your current run-rate, the +40% commit increases monthly spend by ~32% but avoids an estimated 18% loss in customer conversions tied to throttled responses. Happy to compile a short one-pager if Velocit's finance/procurement wants the math.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_rollforward_term_v2.pdf]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@velocit.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@velocit.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Roll-forward amendment and next steps (DocuSign link)

Samantha / Raj — following our sync and internal review, attached is the roll-forward amendment (v2) that implements the +40% committed tokens for 60 days, with the following guardrails:
- Automatic rebaseline conversation 7 days before the end of the 60-day window to land on Q3 commit options.
- Pro-rated credits for any sustained drop below 85% utilization on the extra capacity during the 60 days.
- Same latency/uptime SLA as current contract; Marissa will monitor and send daily usage digests.

Key commercials (summary):
- Effective date: on signing (DocuSign link below).
- Estimated incremental monthly charge: $32k (detailed in attachment).
- Discount: 10% applied to the incremental bands as a one-time concession for this roll-forward.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/track/ABC-VELO-2027

If this looks good, approve in DocuSign and we'll provision within 24 hours. Ben — can you confirm billing code and start date once countersignature is complete?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 650 555 0199
[Attachment: proposed_rollforward_term_v2.pdf]
